market_name: Will US withdraw from NATO before 2027?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether the probability jump is corroborated by credible reporting (official denunciation notice) or is isolated market noise; confirm FEZ/Euro Stoxx futures reaction.
time_plan.1h: Compare FEZ move vs S&P futures to isolate Europe-specific risk premium; watch EUR/USD and Bund yields.
time_plan.2h: Reassess if any official US/NATO statement has emerged; if the probability reverts, expect FEZ to retrace.
time_plan.6h: Evaluate whether European defense names are diverging (rising) from broad index (falling); check for policy headlines.
time_plan.12h: Mark final move vs 700bps threshold; determine whether signal was information leakage or noise and whether it persisted.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp rise in the implied probability that the US formally initiates NATO withdrawal would remove the core European security guarantee, raising the defense/fiscal burden and tail risk for the continent. European large-cap equities are the most directly exposed liquid proxy and would likely sell off on heightened geopolitical/security risk. Only a genuinely large probability jump would produce a >700bps move; absent that, the move is likely modest and noisy.

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Confirm whether the probability move is backed by reporting; check gold spot and DXY reaction.
time_plan.1h: Assess whether dollar is strengthening (which could cap gold) or weakening; watch Treasury yields.
time_plan.2h: Re-evaluate if the market probability sustains or fades; gold response may lag equities.
time_plan.6h: Check for official confirmations/denials and whether safe-haven flows persist across gold, Treasuries, CHF/JPY.
time_plan.12h: Record final gold move; judge whether it reflected genuine risk repricing versus transient noise.

predictions.reasoning: An abrupt increase in US-NATO withdrawal odds signals elevated geopolitical uncertainty and potential fracturing of the Western security order, which historically supports safe-haven demand for gold. Gold is a liquid, broadly-traded hedge. However the reaction is typically smaller and slower than equity risk-off moves, and competing dollar/rate dynamics could offset it, so magnitude and even sign are uncertain within 12h.

evidence_used: Market question framing: formal US initiation of NATO withdrawal / Article 13 denunciation notice before 2027
Primary topic military_conflict, region United States
Historical pattern that major Western security shocks drive European equity risk-off and safe-haven bids
Liquidity of FEZ and GLD as broad proxies
uncertainty_notes: Most intraday probability fluctuations in a long-dated tail-risk market are noise and will not move public assets at all.
A >700bps 12h move requires an extreme, likely headline-confirmed probability jump; baseline expectation is sub-threshold.
Direction could invert: European defense stocks could rally even as broad index falls, and a formal US pullback could paradoxically strengthen USD/US assets.
Gold's reaction can be muted or offset by a stronger dollar in a risk-off episode.

llm_justification.summary: A sharp rise in the implied odds of a formal US NATO withdrawal would most plausibly hit European equities (removal of the US security umbrella, higher fiscal/defense burden, elevated tail risk), with a secondary safe-haven bid for gold. Both mappings are directionally reasonable but modest in expected magnitude and likely below the 700bps tradable threshold unless the probability move is extreme and headline-confirmed; this is a noisy, low-confidence signal.
key_assumptions: A material, non-noise jump in the market's implied probability actually occurs.
Markets interpret rising withdrawal odds as net-negative for European risk assets rather than already-priced.
FEZ and GLD remain liquid and representative proxies during the window.
failure_modes: The probability move is market noise with no underlying information, producing no asset reaction.
The news is already public/priced, so assets do not move on the market signal.
Reaction concentrates in European defense equities (upside) rather than the broad index, making FEZ a weak proxy.
Risk-off manifests as USD strength that suppresses gold, inverting the GLD call.
A formal withdrawal could be read as US-centric isolation that benefits US assets, decoupling from the European proxy.
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
